title: Patrick Mahomes: We showed we can do everything offensively

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Patrick Mahomes: We showed we can do everything offensively
sources.description: The Chiefs cruised to a win in their season opener against the Broncos thanks in large part to running back Kenneth Walker's big night and they moved to 2-0 in a much closer game against the Colts on Sunday night.
